exposure: high pulsatility index in the umbilical artery
decreased pulsatility index in the fetal middle cerebral artery
outcome: Adverse perinatal outcome (stillbirth, neonatal death, hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy)
Surrogate markers of perinatal hypoxia (umbilical cord blood pH, 5-minute Apgar score, admission to NICU)
Cesarean delivery for presumed fetal compromise
cohort: Pregnant women with singleton pregnancies undergoing routine ultrasound examination at 35-37 weeks gestation
finding: While a low cerebroplacental ratio was associated with an increased risk of adverse perinatal outcomes, its predictive performance was poor and added minimal value to the prediction provided by maternal characteristics and medical history.
birth_weight: Neonatal birthweight was an outcome, but no specific inclusion criteria mentioned
